resources.string: Share a favorite drive, a new discovery, or a useful tip.

Be kind and keep posts relevant to Road Conquest and exploring. No harassment, hate, threats, sexual content, graphic violence, or instructions for harm. No spam or personal information about other people. One post per account every 10 minutes, including Forum Plus.

Posts are public and checked automatically before publication. First violation: post removed. Second: post removed and a 7-day forum mute. Third: forum ban. Mutes and bans restrict posting and reactions, not your driving progress.

You can report posts and block authors. Moderation can make mistakes; use the project’s GitHub help page to appeal with your username and post ID.

Text and GIF previews are processed by OpenAI for moderation. GIFs load from Giphy or Tenor. Do not post private location history.

Post GIFs using direct Giphy or Tenor links, and give your posts a subtle highlight.\n\nOne-time purchase for this Road Conquest account. Sign in to the same account to restore it. Does not change moderation rules, bypass the 10-minute cooldown, or remove ads. Deleting your Road Conquest account removes its Forum Plus access.
